files.legend.sop:
@legend.art.draw core.legend
    namespace=art.draw
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    imports=kids.common
    imports=kids.shapes
    doc="The drawing board: a scene graph of shapes and things on a fixed canvas"

@art.draw.picture core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="The drawing. The world state holds canvas (1000 x 700), objects (id, kind, x, y, size, color, fill, rotation, flip, z, parts), background, sky, ground, groundColor, mood, selected, last (what the last command made or changed), history (undo snapshots, at most 50) and future (redo)."
    example="Draw a red house."

@art.draw.picture.selected core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which thing is selected?"
    observe=true
    compute=false

files.operations.sop:
@op.art.draw.add core.operation
    impl=add
    semantics=action
    action=draw.add
    doc="Draws one or more things (kind, count, size, color, parts, place) and answers what it drew. Brings the Drawing tab forward."

@op.art.draw.ground core.operation
    impl=ground
    semantics=action
    action=draw.ground
    doc="Adds grass, sand, snow or water to the ground."

@op.art.draw.scene core.operation
    impl=scene
    semantics=action
    action=draw.scene
    doc="Draws a seeded surprise scene with sun, clouds, house, trees and flowers."

@op.art.draw.setMood core.operation
    impl=setMood
    semantics=action
    action=draw.mood
    doc="Night (dark sky, moon and stars), day (blue sky and sun) or sunset."

@op.art.draw.recolor core.operation
    impl=recolor
    semantics=action
    action=draw.recolor
    doc="Colors an object, a part of it (roof, door, wheels), the sky, the ground or the background."

@op.art.draw.givePart core.operation
    impl=givePart
    semantics=action
    action=draw.givePart
    doc="Colors a named part of a thing: give the house a blue door."

@op.art.draw.resize core.operation
    impl=resize
    semantics=action
    action=draw.resize
    doc="Makes things bigger or smaller by a relative amount."

@op.art.draw.setSize core.operation
    impl=setSize
    semantics=action
    action=draw.setSize
    doc="Sets the size by a word: tiny, small, big, huge."

@op.art.draw.move core.operation
    impl=move
    semantics=action
    action=draw.move
    doc="Moves things to a named region, by a step, or next to / above / under / between other things."

@op.art.draw.nudge core.operation
    impl=nudge
    semantics=action
    action=draw.nudge
    doc="Moves things a bit higher, lower, left or right."

@op.art.draw.turn core.operation
    impl=turn
    semantics=action
    action=draw.turn
    doc="Turns things around, to face a side, upside down or by degrees."

@op.art.draw.remove core.operation
    impl=remove
    semantics=action
    action=draw.remove
    doc="Deletes things, the sky color or the ground; \"everything except\" keeps some things."

@op.art.draw.removeIt core.operation
    impl=removeIt
    semantics=action
    action=draw.removeIt
    doc="Deletes the selected thing or what was just drawn (with the editor open: its selection)."

@op.art.draw.clearEverything core.operation
    impl=clearEverything
    semantics=action
    action=draw.clearAll
    doc="Clears the whole picture (shared with the document editor: with the editor open it clears the document)."

@op.art.draw.newDrawing core.operation
    impl=newDrawing
    semantics=action
    action=draw.new
    doc="Starts a new drawing; undo brings the old one back."

@op.art.draw.undo core.operation
    impl=undo
    semantics=action
    action=draw.undo
    doc="Undoes the last change (history of 50); when the editor tab is open it undoes the document instead."

@op.art.draw.redo core.operation
    impl=redo
    semantics=action
    action=draw.redo
    doc="Redoes what was undone."

@op.art.draw.select core.operation
    impl=select
    semantics=action
    action=draw.select
    doc="Selects a thing (outlined in the tab); also what a click on the tab sends."

@op.art.draw.deselect core.operation
    impl=deselect
    semantics=action
    action=draw.deselect
    doc="Clears the selection."

@op.art.draw.fillMode core.operation
    impl=fillMode
    semantics=action
    action=draw.fill
    doc="Fills in with crayon, solid color, or leaves only an outline."

@op.art.draw.duplicate core.operation
    impl=duplicate
    semantics=action
    action=draw.duplicate
    doc="Copies a thing."

@op.art.draw.describe core.operation
    impl=describe
    semantics=action
    action=draw.describe
    doc="Describes the picture in words: things, places, sky and ground."

@op.art.draw.count core.operation
    impl=count
    semantics=action
    action=draw.count
    doc="Counts things of a kind (and color)."

@op.art.draw.whereIs core.operation
    impl=whereIs
    semantics=action
    action=draw.where
    doc="Tells where a thing is."

@op.art.draw.exists core.operation
    impl=exists
    semantics=action
    action=draw.exists
    doc="Tells whether a thing is in the picture."

@op.art.draw.colorOfThing core.operation
    impl=colorOfThing
    semantics=action
    action=draw.colorOf
    doc="Tells the color of a thing, a part, the sky or the ground."

@op.art.draw.whatsNear core.operation
    impl=whatsNear
    semantics=action
    action=draw.near
    doc="Tells what is near a thing."

@op.art.draw.help core.operation
    impl=help
    semantics=action
    action=draw.help
    doc="Tells what can be drawn."

@op.art.draw.colors core.operation
    impl=colors
    semantics=action
    action=draw.colors
    doc="Tells which colors can be used."

@op.art.draw.save core.operation
    impl=save
    semantics=action
    action=draw.save
    doc="Queues the effect draw.download (PNG or SVG)."

@op.art.draw.openTab core.operation
    impl=openTab
    semantics=action
    action=draw.open
    doc="Brings the Drawing tab forward."
files.patterns.sop:
@pat.art.draw.add core.pattern
    match="[can_you|could_you|will_you|would_you|please_can_you|i_want_you_to|i_would_like_you_to|let_us]? [draw|sketch|paint|add|make|put|create|give_me|show_me|i_want|i_would_like|i_need|draw_me|paint_me|make_me|sketch_me|let_us_draw|i_want_to_draw|i_would_like_to_draw|how_about|can_i_have|i_will_have|i_want_to_add|i_would_like_to_add|throw_in] [a_picture_of|a_drawing_of|a_painting_of|a_sketch_of|a_picture_with]? [a|an|another|1_more|more|some|a_few]? {n:number?} {q:lex.art.draw.quantity?} [of]? {m1:lex.art.draw.mods?} {m2:lex.art.draw.mods?} {m3:lex.art.draw.mods?} {k:lex.art.draw.things} {w:rest?}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.add arg.n={n} arg.q={q} arg.m1={m1} arg.m2={m2} arg.m3={m3} arg.kind={k} arg.kt=\"{k}\" arg.where=\"{w}\""
    kind=request
    priority=12
    example="Draw a red house."
    example="Draw three trees."
    example="Put a big yellow sun in the top right corner."
    example="Add a cloud next to the sun."
    example="Draw a cat under the tree."
    example="Draw a house with a red roof and a blue door."
    example="Add 5 stars."
    example="Draw a small blue fish."
    doc="Draws one or more things: count, size, color, kind, and an optional place or parts (\"in the top right corner\", \"next to the sun\", \"with a red roof\")."

@pat.art.draw.add.the core.pattern
    match="[can_you|could_you|will_you|would_you|please_can_you|i_want_you_to|i_would_like_you_to|let_us]? [draw|sketch|draw_me|sketch_me] the {n:number?} {q:lex.art.draw.quantity?} {m1:lex.art.draw.mods?} {m2:lex.art.draw.mods?} {m3:lex.art.draw.mods?} {k:lex.art.draw.things} {w:rest?}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.add arg.n={n} arg.q={q} arg.m1={m1} arg.m2={m2} arg.m3={m3} arg.kind={k} arg.kt=\"{k}\" arg.where=\"{w}\""
    kind=request
    priority=12
    example="Draw the sun."
    example="Sketch the moon in the sky."

@pat.art.draw.ground core.pattern
    match="[can_you|could_you|will_you|would_you|please_can_you|i_want_you_to|i_would_like_you_to|let_us]? [draw|add|put|make|paint|create|give_me|i_want|i_need|show_me|add_some|draw_some] [me]? [some|the|a_bit_of|more|a|a_lot_of]? {g:lex.art.draw.ground} [on_the_ground|to_the_ground|to_the_picture|to_my_picture|to_my_drawing|to_it|everywhere|at_the_bottom|on_the_floor|to_the_bottom]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.ground arg.g={g}"
    kind=request
    priority=13
    example="Add grass."
    example="Draw some sand."
    example="Add some snow to the ground."
    example="Put water on the ground."

@pat.art.draw.scene core.pattern
    match="[can_you|could_you|will_you|would_you|please_can_you|i_want_you_to|i_would_like_you_to|let_us]? [draw|make|paint|create|show|sketch|give] [me|us]? [a|an|something|anything|a_surprise]? [random|nice|pretty|beautiful|lovely|surprise|new|cool|happy|sunny]? [picture|scene|landscape|drawing|something|surprise|painting|masterpiece]"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.scene"
    kind=request
    priority=13
    example="Draw me a nice picture."
    example="Draw something."
    example="Paint a landscape."

@pat.art.draw.night core.pattern
    match="[make|turn|let|set|change|switch|go] [it|the_picture|the_drawing|the_sky|the_scene|the_day|everything]? [into|to|be|become]? [a|the]? {w:lex.art.draw.times} [time|day|night|please]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.mood arg.w={w}"
    kind=request
    priority=13
    example="Make it night."
    example="Make it day."
    example="Make it a sunny day."
    example="Turn it into sunset."

@pat.art.draw.night.is core.pattern
    match="[it_is|it_was|it_gets|it_becomes] {w:lex.art.draw.times} [time|now|outside]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.mood arg.w={w}"
    kind=request
    priority=12
    example="It is night."

@pat.art.draw.recolor core.pattern
    match="[make|color|colour|paint|turn|dye|fill|change|set|shade|crayon|color_in|colour_in] {t:words(7)} [to|into|in|with|using|be]? {sh:lex.art.draw.shades?} {c:lex.art.draw.colors}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.recolor arg.t=\"{t}\" arg.shade={sh} arg.color={c}"
    kind=request
    priority=13
    example="Color the sun orange."
    example="Make the sky dark blue."
    example="Paint the house blue."
    example="Make the roof of the house green."
    example="Color the door brown."
    example="Make it red."
    example="Change the grass to light green."

@pat.art.draw.part core.pattern
    match="[give|put] {t:words(5)} [a|an|some|its]? {sh:lex.art.draw.shades?} {c:lex.art.draw.colors} {part:words(2)}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.givePart arg.t=\"{t}\" arg.shade={sh} arg.color={c} arg.part=\"{part}\""
    kind=request
    priority=11
    example="Give the house a blue door."
    example="Give the car black wheels."

@pat.art.draw.grow core.pattern
    match="[make|let|turn|get] {t:words(6)} {amt:lex.art.draw.amounts?} {d:lex.art.draw.grow}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.resize arg.t=\"{t}\" arg.amt={amt} arg.d={d}"
    kind=request
    priority=15
    example="Make the house bigger."
    example="Make the tree a bit smaller."
    example="Make it much bigger."
    example="Make the sun twice as big."

@pat.art.draw.enlarge core.pattern
    match="[enlarge|grow|expand|blow_up|inflate|increase|scale_up|magnify] {t:words(6)} {amt:lex.art.draw.amounts?}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.resize arg.t=\"{t}\" arg.amt={amt} arg.d=bigger"
    kind=request
    priority=13
    example="Enlarge the sun."
    example="Blow up the balloon a lot."

@pat.art.draw.shrink core.pattern
    match="[shrink|reduce|decrease|squash|minimize|scale_down|squeeze] {t:words(6)} {amt:lex.art.draw.amounts?}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.resize arg.t=\"{t}\" arg.amt={amt} arg.d=smaller"
    kind=request
    priority=13
    example="Shrink the house."
    example="Shrink the tree a little."

@pat.art.draw.size core.pattern
    match="[make|let|turn|get] {t:words(6)} {s:lex.art.draw.sizes}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.setSize arg.t=\"{t}\" arg.s={s}"
    kind=request
    priority=15
    example="Make the sun huge."
    example="Make it tiny."
    example="Make the tree small."

@pat.art.draw.move core.pattern
    match="[move|shift|push|drag|bring|put|place|set|slide|carry|send|take|lift|lower|raise|nudge|relocate|position] {p:rest}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.move arg.phrase=\"{p}\""
    kind=request
    priority=10
    example="Move the tree to the left."
    example="Move the sun a bit higher."
    example="Put the cat next to the house."
    example="Move it to the top right corner."
    example="Put the red house on the left."
    example="Send the cloud behind the house."

@pat.art.draw.nudge core.pattern
    match="[make|let|get] {t:words(6)} {amt:lex.art.draw.amounts?} {d:lex.art.draw.moves}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.nudge arg.t=\"{t}\" arg.amt={amt} arg.d={d}"
    kind=request
    priority=13
    example="Make the sun higher."
    example="Make the cat a bit lower."

@pat.art.draw.turn core.pattern
    match="{v:lex.art.draw.turnverbs} {t:words(6)} {d:lex.art.draw.turndirs}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.turn arg.verb={v} arg.phrase=\"{t} {d}\""
    kind=request
    priority=14
    example="Turn the car around."
    example="Rotate the house 45 degrees."
    example="Turn it upside down."
    example="Turn the dog to face left."

@pat.art.draw.turn.bare core.pattern
    match="[flip|rotate|spin|tilt|mirror|twist|swivel|lean] {p:rest}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.turn arg.verb=flip arg.phrase=\"{p}\""
    kind=request
    priority=14
    example="Flip the dog."
    example="Tilt the tree."
    example="Spin the star."

@pat.art.draw.face core.pattern
    match="[make|get|let] {p:words(7)} [face|look|point|go|face_to|look_to|looking|facing] [to|towards]? [the]? {d:lex.art.draw.leftright}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.turn arg.phrase=\"{p} face {d}\""
    kind=request
    priority=15

    example="Make the dog look to the right."

@pat.art.draw.upside core.pattern

    emit="@{_} core.request action=draw.turn arg.phrase=\"{p} upside down\""

@world.art.draw core.world
    namespace=art.draw
    version=0.1.0
    legend=$legend.art.draw
    imports=world.core
    imports=world.kids.common
    imports=world.kids.shapes
    formalization=rules
    language=en
    status=fixture
    title="Drawing board (rough.js)"
    summary="draw pictures"
    tab=draw
    tabTitle="Drawing"
    tabAlias=drawing
    tabAlias=paint
    tabAlias=picture
    tabAlias=drawing_board
    tabAlias=canvas
    tabOrder=80
    tabKind=tool
    tabNew=draw.new
    doc="A children's drawing board controlled by voice or text: draw shapes and things (house, tree, sun, cat, rocket ...) by name, color, size and place; move, resize, recolor, turn, copy and delete them; name parts (the roof, the door); make it night; undo; ask what is in the picture; save it as PNG or SVG. The world keeps a scene graph in ctx.state (objects on a 1000 x 700 canvas, sky, ground, selection, undo history); the Drawing tab renders it with rough.js (hand-drawn look, MIT licence, vendored in docs/webchat/vendor/draw/). Geometry of the composite objects lives in scene.mjs and is shared with the tab. Hand-built platform fixture, not produced by the C1 workflow."

Dynamic keys: a core.key with dynamic=true declares a key prefix; a wire may use any key of the form <prefix>.<anything> (for example where.owner or arg.count on core.question and core.request).     tabAlias=graph
    tabAlias=charts
    tabAlias=graphs
    tabOrder=70
    tabKind=tool
    title="Charts (Chart.js)"
    summary="draw charts"
    doc="Talk with charts drawn by the Chart.js library in the Charts tab: bar, line, pie, doughnut, radar, polar area and scatter. Charts are built from the conversation (what people have, the prices of the toys, a shopping list, the legs of the sea animals) or from numbers you type, and every number of such a chart keeps the ids of the wires it came from. Change the type, title, colors, order, orientation, labels, legend and stacking by language, ask about the data (biggest, total, average, difference, percentage), keep several charts, and download a chart as a picture. State lives in ctx.state; the tab renders it. Hand-built platform fixture, not produced by the C1 workflow."

files.samples/hansel-and-gretel.md:
# Hansel and Gretel

> Source: a short English retelling of the fairy tale collected by the Brothers Grimm (Kinder- und Hausmärchen, 1812). The tale is in the public domain; this retelling was written for this project and is released under CC0 (public domain dedication).

## The Poor Woodcutter

Once upon a time a poor woodcutter lived at the edge of a great forest with his two children and their stepmother. The boy was called Hansel and his little sister was called Gretel. The woodcutter was their father. He loved his children, but the family had almost nothing to eat. The stepmother was cruel and she hated the children.

One evening the stepmother spoke to the father. "There is not enough bread for four," she said. "Tomorrow you must take the children deep into the forest and leave them there." The father wept, but he agreed in the end. Hansel heard every word through the thin wall of the bedroom. He told his sister about the plan. "Do not cry, Gretel," he whispered. "I will find a way."

Hansel crept out of the house at night and filled his pockets with white pebbles. In the morning the father led the children into the forest. Hansel dropped a pebble on the path every few steps. The father lit a fire and went away. The children waited until the moon rose. The white pebbles shone in the moonlight and showed them the way home. The father was glad to see them, but the stepmother was furious.

## Lost in the Forest

A few days later the stepmother made the father take the children into the forest again. This time Hansel had no pebbles, so he scattered crumbs of bread on the path. The birds ate every crumb. When night came, Hansel and Gretel were lost. They walked for three days and grew hungry and tired.

At last they saw a white bird. It led them to a little house in a clearing. The walls of the house were made of bread and the roof was made of cake. The windows were made of clear sugar. Hansel ate a piece of the roof and Gretel ate a piece of the window. "Nibble, nibble, little mouse, who is nibbling at my house?" called a voice from inside.

The door opened and an old woman came out. She was a witch, but she smiled kindly at the children. "Come in, dear children," said the witch. "You will have food and a warm bed." Hansel and Gretel followed her into the house. They did not know that the witch built her house of bread to catch hungry children.

## The Witch's Oven

Early the next morning the witch locked Hansel in a small cage. She made Gretel carry water and cook for her brother. "Fatten him up," said the witch. "I will eat him when he is fat." Every day the witch came to the cage and said, "Hansel, put out your finger so that I can feel how fat you are." Hansel held out a thin bone instead of his finger. The witch could not see well, so she thought the bone was his finger. She was angry that Hansel stayed so thin.

After four weeks the witch lost her patience. "Gretel, climb into the oven and see if it is hot enough," she ordered. Gretel guessed the witch's plan. "I do not know how," said Gretel. "Show me first." The witch bent over and put her head into the oven. Gretel pushed her with all her strength and shut the iron door. The witch burned in her own oven.

Gretel ran to the cage and set her brother free. "The witch is dead!" she cried. Hansel and Gretel hugged each other and danced with joy. They found pearls and jewels in every corner of the witch's house. They filled their pockets and their aprons and set off for home.

## Home Again

On their way they came to a wide lake. A white duck carried Hansel and Gretel across the water, one after the other. Soon they saw the woodcutter's house through the trees. They ran inside and threw their arms around their father. The father had not had a happy hour since he lost the children. The stepmother was dead. Gretel shook out her apron and the pearls rolled over the floor. From that day on the family lived together without worry, and the father was never poor again.

    tab=documents

    tabAlias=documents
    tabAlias=reader
    tabAlias=document_reader
    tabAlias=my_documents
    tabAlias=library
    tabAlias=files
    tabAlias=my_files
    tabOrder=80
    tabKind=tool
    title="Document reader"
    summary="answer questions about your documents"

No LLM. State lives in ctx.state; the tab renders it. Hand-built platform fixture, not produced by the C1 workflow."

files.data/README.md:
# Data of the world geo.map

All files here and the knowledge base (`kb.sop`) and place lexicon (`lexicon.sop`) are generated by `scripts/build-geo-data.mjs` from npm packages. Do not edit them by hand.

| Data | Package (version) | Licence | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Countries: names, capitals, region, borders, area, currencies, languages, landlocked | world-countries 5.1.0 (mledoze/countries) | ODbL 1.0 (attribution and share-alike for the database) | `geo.map.country` wires |
| Country population | country-json 2.3.0 (country-by-population, about 2018 estimates) | MIT | `pop` of countries (Timor-Leste added by hand: World Bank 2018) |
| Cities | all-the-cities 3.1.0 (GeoNames gazetteer, https://www.geonames.org) | CC BY 4.0 (attribution required) | `geo.map.city` wires: 246 capitals, every city of 500,000+ people, Romanian and Moldovan cities of 30,000+ (1001 in all) |
| Country outlines (offline base map) | world-atlas 2.0.2 countries-50m (Natural Earth) | public domain | `docs/webchat/vendor/map/countries-50m.json`, bounding boxes of countries (`bb`) |
| Groups (EU, NATO, Nordic ...) | hand-written, as of 2024 | none | `geo.map.region` wires of kind `group` |

Every KB wire carries its source and licence in `core.source`. Population figures are rough and dated; city populations are GeoNames city-proper values (a few large cities are much smaller than their metro areas).

Counts: 250 countries and territories (194 independent), 1001 cities, 38 regions, 1464 lexicon names. Capitals without a GeoNames match (no city wire; the capital name is still known): EH:El Aaiún, IO:Diego Garcia, TK:Fakaofo.

Rebuild: `npm i world-countries@5.1.0 all-the-cities@3.1.0 country-json@2.3.0 world-atlas@2.0.2 topojson-client@3.1.0` in a temporary directory, then `node scripts/build-geo-data.mjs --modules <dir>/node_modules`.

files.legend.sop:
@legend.kids.arith core.legend
    namespace=kids.arith
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    imports=kids.common
    doc="Counting things people have, events that change the counts, totals, comparisons and bare arithmetic"

@kids.arith.holding core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Someone has a number of items of one kind. A statement sets the count; later events change it."
    example="Tom has 5 apples."
    negative="Tom likes apples."

@kids.arith.holding.owner core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who has them?"

@kids.arith.holding.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.holding.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many are there?"
    observe=true
    compute=true

@kids.arith.change core.type
    extends=core.event
    doc="Something happens to the number of items someone has. Events are applied in dialog order (core.seq)."
    example="Ana gives Tom 3 apples."

@kids.arith.change.who core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is it about (who gives, gets, eats, loses, buys or breaks)?"

@kids.arith.change.to core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who receives the items?"

@kids.arith.change.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.change.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many items are involved?"

@kids.arith.give core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="One person gives some items to another person: who gives, to receives."
    example="Ana gives Tom 3 apples."

@kids.arith.receive core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="Someone gets, receives or finds some items."
    example="Tom finds 2 marbles."

@kids.arith.eat core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="Someone eats some items."
    example="Tom ate 2 apples."

@kids.arith.lose core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="Someone loses some items."
    example="Mia lost 3 marbles."

@kids.arith.buy core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="Someone buys some items (only the counts are tracked here, not the money)."
    example="Ben buys 4 pencils."

@kids.arith.break core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="Someone breaks some items."
    example="Sam broke 2 pencils."

@kids.arith.total core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="How many items of one kind there are altogether, over everybody or over two named people."
    example="How many apples are there altogether?"

@kids.arith.total.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.total.who1 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the first person to count?"

@kids.arith.total.who2 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the second person to count?"

@kids.arith.total.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many are there altogether?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.leader core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Who has the most items of one kind, or who of two named people has more."
    example="Who has more apples, Tom or Ana?"

@kids.arith.leader.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.leader.who1 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the first person to compare?"

@kids.arith.leader.who2 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the second person to compare?"

@kids.arith.leader.winner core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who has more?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.gap core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="How many more (or fewer) items of one kind the first person has than the second."
    example="How many more apples does Tom have than Ana?"

@kids.arith.gap.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.gap.who1 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the first person?"

@kids.arith.gap.who2 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the second person?"

@kids.arith.gap.diff core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is the difference between the two counts?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.verdict core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Yes or no: does the first person have more items than the second?"
    example="Does Tom have more apples than Ana?"

@kids.arith.verdict.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.verdict.who1 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the first person?"

@kids.arith.verdict.who2 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the second person?"

@kids.arith.verdict.answer core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Is it yes or no?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.has core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Yes or no: does someone have any items of one kind?"
    example="Does Tom have any apples?"

@kids.arith.has.owner core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who might have them?"

@kids.arith.has.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.has.answer core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Is it yes or no?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.calc core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A bare calculation of two numbers: plus, minus, times, divided_by."
    example="What is 7 plus 5?"

@kids.arith.calc.op core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which operation (plus, minus, times, divided_by)?"

@kids.arith.calc.a core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is the first number?"

@kids.arith.calc.b core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is the second number?"

@kids.arith.calc.result core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is the result?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.half core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Half of a number."
    example="What is half of 10?"

@kids.arith.half.n core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="Which number?"

@kids.arith.half.result core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is half of it?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.double core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Double a number."
    example="What is double 6?"

@kids.arith.double.n core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="Which number?"

@kids.arith.double.result core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is double it?"
    compute=true

@pat.kids.arith.has core.pattern
    match="{who:agent} [now]? [has|have|had] [got|now]? {n:number} {item:lex.kids.arith.items} [now|left|today|at_first|at_the_start]?"
    emit="@{_} kids.arith.holding owner={who} count={n} item={item}"
    kind=statement
    priority=9
    example="Tom has 5 apples."

@pat.kids.arith.has.a core.pattern
    match="{who:agent} [now]? [has|have|had] [got]? [a|an] {item:lex.kids.arith.items}"
    emit="@{_} kids.arith.holding owner={who} count=1 item={item}"
    kind=statement
    priority=10
    example="Mia has a pear."

@pat.kids.arith.has.no core.pattern

    kind=statement
    priority=10
    example="Ben has no marbles."

@pat.kids.arith.has.start core.pattern

    emit="@{_} kids.arith.holding owner={who} count={n} item={item}\n@{_1} kids.arith.holding owner={who} count={m} item={item2}"
    kind=statement
    priority=11
    example="Tom has 4 apples and 3 pears."

@pat.kids.arith.give.direct core.pattern

@pat.kids.common.hello core.pattern
    match="[hello|hi|hey] [there]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=chat.greet"
    kind=chat
    priority=10
    example="Hello!"

@pat.kids.common.name core.pattern
    match="[what_is|what_are|what_was] [your_name|you_called] [again|now]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=chat.name"
    kind=chat
    priority=12
    example="What is your name?"
    example="What are you called?"

@pat.kids.common.name.call core.pattern
    match="[what_do_i_call_you|what_should_i_call_you|what_can_i_call_you|tell_me_your_name|may_i_ask_your_name|can_i_ask_your_name|can_you_tell_me_your_name]"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=chat.name"
    kind=chat
    priority=12
    example="What should I call you?"

@pat.kids.common.meet core.pattern
    match="[hello|hi|hey]? [there]? my name is {n:words(3)}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=chat.meet arg.name=\"{n}\""
    kind=chat
    priority=12
    example="Hi, my name is Ben."
    example="My name is Mia Lee."

    match="[hello|hi|hey]? [there]? [call_me|you_can_call_me|please_call_me|everybody_calls_me|i_am_called|i_am_named] {n:words(3)}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=chat.meet arg.name=\"{n}\""
    kind=chat
    priority=12
    example="Call me Sam."
    example="You can call me Ana."

@pat.kids.common.myname core.pattern
    match="[what_is|what_was] [my_name|my_name_again]"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=chat.myname"
    kind=chat
    priority=12
    example="What is my name?"

@pat.kids.common.myname2 core.pattern
    match="[do_you_know|do_you_remember|can_you_tell_me] [what|who] [my_name_is|i_am|you_call_me|your_user_is]"

    kind=chat
    priority=12
    example="Do you remember what my name is?"

@pat.kids.common.myname3 core.pattern
    match="[who_am_i|do_you_know_my_name|do_you_remember_my_name|do_you_know_who_i_am|what_do_you_call_me|what_am_i_called]"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=chat.myname"
    kind=chat
    priority=12

    priority=10
    example="Goodbye!"

files.legend.sop:
@legend.kids.shapes core.legend
    namespace=kids.shapes
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    imports=kids.common
    doc="Flat shapes, colors and the colors of everyday things"

@kids.shapes.shape core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A flat shape and how many sides and corners it has."
    example="A hexagon has 6 sides."
    negative="A banana is yellow."

@kids.shapes.shape.name core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which shape is it?"

@kids.shapes.shape.sides core.key
    value=integer
    ask="How many sides does it have?"

@kids.shapes.shape.corners core.key
    value=integer
    ask="How many corners does it have?"

@kids.shapes.shape.summary core.key
    value=string
    ask="What is it like?"
    compute=true
    observe=false

@kids.shapes.family core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A shape is, or is not, a kind of shape (a square is a rectangle) or a round shape. holds=false is an explicit no."
    example="A square is a rectangle."

@kids.shapes.family.shape core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which shape is asked about?"

@kids.shapes.family.kind core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which kind of shape is asked about?"

@kids.shapes.family.holds core.key
    value=boolean
    ask="Is the shape of that kind?"
    compute=true

@kids.shapes.family.because core.key
    value=string
    ask="Why is it not so?"

@kids.shapes.color core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A color and whether it is a primary or secondary color."
    example="Red is a primary color."

@kids.shapes.color.name core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which color is it?"

@kids.shapes.color.kind core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Is it a primary, secondary or neutral color?"

@kids.shapes.color.is_kind core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which kind of color is asked about?"
    compute=true
    observe=false

@kids.shapes.mix core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Mixing two colors gives a third color."
    example="Red and yellow make orange."

@kids.shapes.mix.first core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which is the first color?"

@kids.shapes.mix.second core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which is the second color?"

@kids.shapes.mix.result core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which color do they make?"
    compute=true

@kids.shapes.mix.recipe core.key
    value=string
    ask="Which colors make it?"
    compute=true
    observe=false

@kids.shapes.thing core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="An everyday thing: its typical colors and the flat shape it looks like. Several wires may describe the same thing."
    example="A banana is yellow."
    example="A clock is a circle."

@kids.shapes.thing.name core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which thing is it?"

@kids.shapes.thing.color core.key
    value=atom
    ask="What color is it usually?"
    card=many
    compute=true

@kids.shapes.thing.shape core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which shape does it look like?"

@kids.shapes.thing.article core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which article goes with the name (a, an, the or none)?"

@kids.shapes.thing.is_color core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which color is asked about?"
    compute=true
    observe=false

@pat.kids.shop.money core.pattern
    match="i [only]? have [got]? {n:number} [lei|leu] [now|left|today|in_my_wallet|in_my_piggy_bank|with_me|to_spend]?"
    emit="@{_} kids.shop.money count={n} unit=leu"
    kind=statement
    priority=10
    example="I have 20 lei."

@pat.kids.shop.money.start core.pattern
    match="i [start|started|begin|began] with {n:number} [lei|leu]"
    emit="@{_} kids.shop.money count={n} unit=leu"
    kind=statement
    priority=10
    example="I start with 30 lei."

@pat.kids.shop.money.wallet core.pattern
    match="my [wallet|piggy_bank|purse|money_box] [has|had|holds|contains] {n:number} [lei|leu]"
    emit="@{_} kids.shop.money count={n} unit=leu"
    kind=statement
    priority=10
    example="My wallet has 15 lei."

@pat.kids.shop.income core.pattern
    match="i [get|got|find|found|receive|received|earn|earned|win|won|save|saved] {n:number} [more]? [lei|leu]"
    emit="@{_} kids.shop.income count={n} unit=leu"
    kind=statement
    priority=10
    example="I found 5 lei."

@pat.kids.shop.income.from core.pattern
    match="[my]? [mom|mum|dad|mother|father|grandma|grandpa|grandmother|grandfather|aunt|uncle|friend|teacher|sister|brother]? {g:agent?} [gives|gave|give] me {n:number} [more]? [lei|leu]"
    emit="@{_} kids.shop.income count={n} unit=leu"
    kind=statement
    priority=10
    example="Ana gives me 10 lei."

@pat.kids.shop.expense core.pattern
    match="i [spend|spent|lose|lost|pay|paid|give_away|gave_away] {n:number} [lei|leu]"
    emit="@{_} kids.shop.expense count={n} unit=leu"
    kind=statement
    priority=10
    example="I spent 5 lei."

@pat.kids.shop.buy.a core.pattern

    namespace=kids.shop
    version=0.1.0
    legend=$legend.kids.shop
    imports=world.core
    imports=world.kids.common
    formalization=rules
    language=en

    namespace=kids.tasks
    version=0.1.0

    ask="Is it todo, done or removed?"

    impl=addItems
    semantics=action

@op.kids.tasks.remind core.operation
    impl=remindMe
    semantics=action
    action=tasks.remind
    doc="Adds an item to the reminders list (no real timer)."

@op.kids.tasks.remove core.operation
    impl=removeItem
    semantics=action
    action=tasks.remove
    doc="Removes items from one list or from whichever list has them; says when an item is not there."

@op.kids.tasks.done core.operation
    impl=finishItem
    semantics=action
    action=tasks.done
    doc="Marks an item as done; asks which one when several match; says when it is already done."

@op.kids.tasks.notDone core.operation
    impl=notDone
    semantics=action
    action=tasks.notDone
    doc="The user says they did NOT do something (I didn't buy milk): nothing is ticked off, the answer says so and offers to tick it off later."

@op.kids.tasks.check core.operation
    impl=checkItem
    semantics=action
    action=tasks.check
    doc="Tells whether an item is done (yes) or still to do or unknown (missing)."

@op.kids.tasks.show core.operation
    impl=showList
    semantics=action
    action=tasks.show
    doc="Lists the items still to do on a list and the items that are done."

@op.kids.tasks.pending core.operation
    impl=pendingItems
    semantics=action
    action=tasks.pending
    doc="Lists the items of a list that are not done yet."

@op.kids.tasks.count core.operation

    doc="Counts the items on a list."

@op.kids.tasks.countPending core.operation
    impl=countPending
    semantics=action
    action=tasks.countPending
    doc="Counts the items of a list that are not done yet."

@op.kids.tasks.has core.operation
    impl=hasItem
    semantics=action
    action=tasks.has
    doc="Tells whether an item is on a list."

@op.kids.tasks.clear core.operation
    impl=clearList
    semantics=action
    action=tasks.clear
    doc="Removes every item of a list."

@op.ui.avatar.setPart core.operation
    impl=setPart
    semantics=action
    action=avatar.setPart
    doc="Sets a component by name and by synonym (visor eyes, a dish on top, a medical mask). When only another character has it, the avatar becomes that character. Every changing command also brings the avatar tab forward: ctx.request(\"ui.openTab\")."

@op.ui.avatar.setPartUnknown core.operation
    impl=setPartUnknown
    semantics=action
    action=avatar.setPartUnknown
    doc="A component named with words that are not a known variant: says what is possible. Every changing command also brings the avatar tab forward: ctx.request(\"ui.openTab\")."

@op.ui.avatar.step core.operation
    impl=step
    semantics=action
    action=avatar.step
    doc="Next, previous or different variant of a component (dir=next|previous|different). Every changing command also brings the avatar tab forward: ctx.request(\"ui.openTab\")."

@op.ui.avatar.resizePart core.operation
    impl=resizePart
    semantics=action
    action=avatar.resizePart
    doc="Bigger or smaller (dir=bigger|smaller) for a part. Emoji eyes step along the sizes that really differ (small, pupils, big pupils); the robot and the person cannot scale their eyes, so the answer offers the styles that look bigger or smaller. Every changing command also brings the avatar tab forward: ctx.request(\"ui.openTab\")."

@op.ui.avatar.nameOf core.operation
    impl=nameOf
    semantics=action
    action=avatar.nameOf
    doc="The bare name of the avatar. kids.common speaks it as the assistant's name (the avatar and the assistant are one character): ctx.request(\"avatar.nameOf\"). Every changing command also brings the avatar tab forward: ctx.request(\"ui.openTab\")."

@op.ui.avatar.resetPart core.operation
    impl=resetPart
    semantics=action
    action=avatar.resetPart
    doc="Back to the default variant of one component. Every changing command also brings the avatar tab forward: ctx.request(\"ui.openTab\")."

@op.ui.avatar.removePart core.operation
    impl=removePart
    semantics=action
    action=avatar.removePart
    doc="Takes off a component that can be absent (mask, glasses, antenna) or a hat. Every changing command also brings the avatar tab forward: ctx.request(\"ui.openTab\")."

@op.ui.avatar.removeAll core.operation
    impl=removeAll
    semantics=action
    action=avatar.removeAll
    doc="Takes off everything that can be taken off. Every changing command also brings the avatar tab forward: ctx.request(\"ui.openTab\")."

@op.ui.avatar.setColor core.operation
    impl=setColor
    semantics=action
    action=avatar.setColor
    doc="Sets a color part to the nearest entry of the style palette for a named color. Every changing command also brings the avatar tab forward: ctx.request(\"ui.openTab\")."

@op.ui.avatar.shiftColor core.operation
    impl=shiftColor
    semantics=action
    action=avatar.shiftColor
    doc="Makes a color part lighter or darker, one palette step. Every changing command also brings the avatar tab forward: ctx.request(\"ui.openTab\")."

@op.ui.avatar.askColor core.operation
    impl=askColor
    semantics=action
    action=avatar.askColor
    doc="Tells the color of a part in words. Every changing command also brings the avatar tab forward: ctx.request(\"ui.openTab\")."

@op.ui.avatar.listColors core.operation
    impl=listColors

files.world.sop:
@world.ui.help core.world
    namespace=ui.help
    version=0.1.0
    legend=$legend.ui.help
    imports=world.core
    imports=world.kids.common
    formalization=rules
    language=en
    status=fixture
    title="Contextual help"
    summary=""
    doc="Help that knows the app: what can be said on the active tab (varied pattern examples of the tab world, rotating on repeat), how to do something (a search over the examples of all worlds), the rules and current state of the active game, why the last sentence was not understood, and the capabilities answer. Also exports didYouMean(), used by the dialog layer to suggest the closest known commands after a failed sentence (spec 07 section 8). State lives in ctx.state. Hand-built platform fixture, not produced by the C1 workflow."
